Package pokemonjavaedition

Class Pokemon

java.lang.Object
pokemonjavaedition.Pokemon
public class Pokemon extends Object
It creates an instance of a pokemon, which can be without attributes, if you just need to initialize one, or with different stats describing its characteristics.

  • Constructor Details

    • Pokemon

      public Pokemon()
      It creates an empty pokemon, useful if you want to just initialize it without giving it any information.

    • Pokemon

      public Pokemon(String name, String type, pokemonjavaedition.PokeMove[] moveSet, double[] stats, double[] stages, ImageIcon frontSprite, ImageIcon backSprite)
      It creates a full built pokemon, with all its characteristics to make it works.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the pokemon
      type - the type of the pokemon
      moveSet - an arry with all his moves
      stats - its main stats
      stages - the stages of its attack, defense, special and speed stats in this specified order
      frontSprite - its front sprite image
      backSprite - its back sprite image

    • changeStage

      public void changeStage(String sign, int stat)
      It makes one of the stages in the array stages of a pokemon to go -1 or +1 or remain unmodified if it is already at +6 or -6, which is the max boost/nerf that a stat can receive in pokemon games.
      Parameters:
      sign - it can be + or -, if the stage has to be increased or decreased
      stat - the stat of which stage is increased or decreased.
